kiswahili_now: Serikali ya kitaifa inapanga kutumia {amount} mwaka {fy}.

english: Of this, {amount} ({pct}) goes to interest and pensions, paid before anything else.
kiswahili_now: Kati ya hizo, {amount} ({pct}) zinaenda kwa riba na pensheni, zinazolipwa kabla ya kitu kingine chochote.
Mgao sawa wa Kaunti ya {name} mwaka {fy} ni {amount}.

english: In {fy}, {name} County spent {pct} of its development budget.
kiswahili_now: Mwaka {fy}, Kaunti ya {name} ilitumia {pct} ya bajeti yake ya maendeleo.

Every table on this site as a file, from data release {release}. Free to reuse with credit.

english: Every figure, with its source, page, stage and label
kiswahili_now: Kila takwimu, na chanzo, ukurasa, hatua na lebo yake

english: All 87 votes by sector, this year and last
kiswahili_now: Mafungu yote 87 kwa sekta, mwaka huu na uliopita
Kila mradi wa maendeleo wa kitaifa

english: One file per vote and per county
kiswahili_now: Faili moja kwa kila fungu na kila kaunti

english: Each vote and each county has its own JSON file, with every figure behind its page and the documents they come from.
kiswahili_now: Kila fungu na kila kaunti ina faili yake ya JSON, yenye kila takwimu ya ukurasa wake na nyaraka zinakotoka.

english: You may copy, share and adapt the data, for any purpose, if you credit {name} and link to the page.
kiswahili_now: Unaweza kunakili, kushiriki na kubadilisha data, kwa madhumuni yoyote, ukitaja {name} na kuweka kiungo cha ukurasa.

english: Cite a figure by its release and id, for example:
kiswahili_now: Taja takwimu kwa toleo na kitambulisho chake, kwa mfano:

english: Figures carry a stage. Never add figures of different stages: a recommendation, an estimate and a law are different numbers for the same thing.
kiswahili_now: Takwimu zina hatua. Usiwahi kujumlisha takwimu za hatua tofauti: pendekezo, makadirio na sheria ni namba tofauti za kitu kimoja.

english: Each release is a dated snapshot of every figure. Changed figures are listed with their old and new values.
kiswahili_now: Kila toleo ni picha ya tarehe fulani ya kila takwimu. Takwimu zilizobadilika zinaorodheshwa na thamani za zamani na mpya.

english: No figure was changed or removed.
Every number we work out ourselves, and how. Each is tagged "Our calculation" where it appears, and each has a test.
kiswahili_now: Kila namba tunayokokotoa wenyewe, na jinsi tunavyofanya. Kila moja ina alama "Hesabu yetu" inapoonekana, na kila moja ina jaribio.

english: We never estimate, interpolate or scale a missing figure. A figure we do not have shows as not loaded.
kiswahili_now: Hatukadirii, hatujazi wala hatukuzi takwimu inayokosekana. Takwimu tusiyokuwa nayo inaonyeshwa kuwa haijapakiwa.

english: Supply plus Appropriations-in-Aid, recurrent and development, as the Appropriation Act prints them. This is the gross amount.
kiswahili_now: Fedha za Hazina pamoja na Mapato ya Mashirika, ya kawaida na ya maendeleo, kama Sheria ya Matumizi inavyoyachapisha. Hiki ni kiasi cha jumla.

english: The sum of its votes. Which votes are in each sector comes from the Parliamentary Budget Office's tables, not from our judgment.
kiswahili_now: Jumla ya mafungu yake. Mafungu yaliyo katika kila sekta yanatoka kwenye majedwali ya Ofisi ya Bajeti ya Bunge, si uamuzi wetu.

english: (this year minus last year) divided by last year, times 100. Approved against approved, in cash terms, adding the same votes in both years.
kiswahili_now: (mwaka huu kutoa mwaka jana) gawanya kwa mwaka jana, mara 100. Iliyoidhinishwa dhidi ya iliyoidhinishwa, kwa thamani ya pesa, ikijumlisha mafungu yale yale katika miaka yote miwili.

english: Figures of different stages are shown side by side, never added, and no change is worked out between them.
kiswahili_now: Takwimu za hatua tofauti zinaonyeshwa kando kwa kando, hazijumlishwi, na hakuna mabadiliko yanayokokotolewa kati yake.

english: A part divided by total spending, times 100, rounded to whole shillings. Below KSh 1 it is given in cents, and below 10 cents as "under 10 cents".
kiswahili_now: Sehemu gawanya kwa matumizi yote, mara 100, kwa shilingi nzima. Chini ya KSh 1 inatolewa kwa senti, na chini ya senti 10 kama "chini ya senti 10".

english: Development money spent divided by the development budget, times 100, as the Controller of Budget prints it. We recompute each printed percentage from the amounts.
kiswahili_now: Pesa za maendeleo zilizotumika gawanya kwa bajeti ya maendeleo, mara 100, kama Mdhibiti wa Bajeti anavyochapisha. Tunakokotoa upya kila asilimia iliyochapishwa kutoka kwa viwango.

english: A county's wages divided by its total revenue, times 100. Our division must reproduce every ratio the Controller of Budget names, or the build stops.
kiswahili_now: Mishahara ya kaunti gawanya kwa mapato yake yote, mara 100. Hesabu yetu lazima ilingane na kila uwiano anaoutaja Mdhibiti wa Bajeti, la sivyo ujenzi unasimama.

english: A county's share compared with the limit in the law: wages at most 35% of revenue, development at least 30%. The report's own finding comes first, and the law is quoted.
kiswahili_now: Sehemu ya kaunti ikilinganishwa na kikomo cha sheria: mishahara isizidi 35% ya mapato, maendeleo yasipungue 30%. Matokeo ya ripoti yenyewe yanakuja kwanza, na sheria inanukuliwa.

english: Two rules, from the Development Estimates alone: money last year and none this year; and one specific name under more than one vote. Each gives a question, never a finding.
kiswahili_now: Kanuni mbili, kutoka kwa Makadirio ya Maendeleo pekee: pesa mwaka jana na hakuna mwaka huu; na jina moja mahususi chini ya zaidi ya fungu moja. Kila moja inatoa swali, si uamuzi.

english: Your amount times each part's share of spending, in whole shillings. Leftover shillings go to the largest remainders, so the parts add back to your amount.
kiswahili_now: Kiasi chako mara sehemu ya kila kipengele ya matumizi, kwa shilingi nzima. Shilingi zinazobaki zinaenda kwa masalio makubwa zaidi, ili sehemu zijumlike kuwa kiasi chako.

english: Whole days from today in Nairobi to the date the law fixes, worked out again in your browser.
kiswahili_now: Siku nzima kutoka leo Nairobi hadi tarehe iliyowekwa na sheria, zikikokotolewa upya kwenye kivinjari chako.

english: Every figure we have changed or removed after publishing it, with the old value, the new one and why.
kiswahili_now: Kila takwimu tuliyobadilisha au kuondoa baada ya kuichapisha, na thamani ya zamani, mpya na sababu.

english: No published figure has been corrected yet.
kiswahili_now: Hakuna takwimu iliyochapishwa ambayo imesahihishwa bado.

english: Reporting is not open yet. Until a corrections contact is set up, this page lists corrections only.
kiswahili_now: Kuripoti bado hakujafunguliwa. Hadi mawasiliano ya masahihisho yawekwe, ukurasa huu unaorodhesha masahihisho pekee.

english: {n} short explainers on how Kenya's budget works, each with its figures and sources.
kiswahili_now: Maelezo mafupi {n} kuhusu jinsi bajeti ya Kenya inavyofanya kazi, kila moja na takwimu na vyanzo vyake.

english: The explainers are in English, each with a summary in Kiswahili.
kiswahili_now: Maelezo haya yako kwa Kiingereza, kila moja likiwa na muhtasari kwa Kiswahili.

english: The words this site uses, in plain language, with their Kiswahili.
kiswahili_now: Maneno yanayotumika kwenye tovuti hii, kwa lugha rahisi, pamoja na Kiswahili chake.

english: A ministry, state department or agency that Parliament gives money to in the Appropriation Act.
kiswahili_now: Wizara, idara ya serikali au shirika ambalo Bunge linalipa pesa katika Sheria ya Matumizi.

english: A part of a vote's work with its own money, aim and targets, such as Road Transport.
kiswahili_now: Sehemu ya kazi ya fungu yenye pesa, lengo na malengo yake, kama Usafiri wa Barabara.

english: Money a vote gets from the Exchequer, the national government's main account.
kiswahili_now: Pesa ambazo fungu linapata kutoka Hazina, akaunti kuu ya serikali ya kitaifa.

english: Money an agency raises itself, such as fees, and is allowed to spend. Supply plus Appropriations-in-Aid is the gross amount.
kiswahili_now: Pesa ambazo shirika hukusanya lenyewe, kama ada, na linaruhusiwa kuzitumia. Fedha za Hazina pamoja na Mapato ya Mashirika ni kiasi cha jumla.

english: The running costs of government: salaries, operations and transfers.
kiswahili_now: Gharama za kuendesha serikali: mishahara, shughuli na uhamisho wa fedha.

english: Money for building things that last, such as roads, clinics and water projects.
kiswahili_now: Pesa za kujenga vitu vya kudumu, kama barabara, zahanati na miradi ya maji.

english: Spending paid before anything else, mostly interest on public debt and pensions. It is not in any ministry's vote.
kiswahili_now: Matumizi yanayolipwa kabla ya kitu kingine, hasa riba ya deni la umma na pensheni. Hayamo katika fungu la wizara yoyote.

english: The National Treasury's statement of the year's priorities and spending ceilings, due in Parliament by 15 February.
kiswahili_now: Taarifa ya Hazina ya Kitaifa ya vipaumbele vya mwaka na viwango vya juu vya matumizi, inayopaswa kufika Bungeni kufikia 15 Februari.

english: The share of the development budget actually spent in a year, as the Controller of Budget reports it.
kiswahili_now: Sehemu ya bajeti ya maendeleo iliyotumika kweli katika mwaka, kama Mdhibiti wa Bajeti anavyoripoti.

english: Amounts owed for goods, services and works already delivered but not yet paid.
kiswahili_now: Madeni ya bidhaa, huduma na kazi zilizokwisha kutolewa lakini bado hazijalipwa.

english: Money a county raises itself, such as rates, licences and fees.
kiswahili_now: Pesa ambazo kaunti hukusanya yenyewe, kama kodi za ardhi, leseni na ada.

english: The National Government Constituencies Development Fund: national money run by constituency committees, never part of county money.
kiswahili_now: Mfuko wa Maendeleo wa Maeneo Bunge wa Serikali ya Kitaifa: pesa za kitaifa zinazosimamiwa na kamati za maeneo bunge, si sehemu ya pesa za kaunti.

english: A dated snapshot of every figure on this site. Citing the release lets anyone find the exact number you used.
kiswahili_now: Picha ya tarehe fulani ya kila takwimu kwenye tovuti hii. Kutaja toleo kunamwezesha yeyote kupata namba halisi uliyotumia.

english: Set by the County Allocation of Revenue Act, {change}.
kiswahili_now: Umewekwa na Sheria ya Ugavi wa Mapato ya Kaunti, {change}.

english: Embed this card on your site
kiswahili_now: Weka kadi hii kwenye tovuti yako

english: Paste this code into your page. The card runs no script and sets no cookie.
kiswahili_now: Bandika msimbo huu kwenye ukurasa wako. Kadi haiendeshi programu wala haiweki kuki.

english: {n} pictures to share, each carrying its figures, labels, sources and data release, so a screenshot keeps them.
kiswahili_now: Picha {n} za kushiriki, kila moja ikiwa na takwimu, lebo, vyanzo na toleo la data, ili picha ya skrini izibakize.

english: Official figures, each with its stage.
kiswahili_now: Takwimu rasmi, kila moja na hatua yake.

english: Figures of different stages are shown side by side and never added.
kiswahili_now: Takwimu za hatua tofauti zinaonyeshwa kando kwa kando na hazijumlishwi.
Mapato, pamoja na ada za mashirika

english: Interest as a share of ordinary revenue
kiswahili_now: Riba kama sehemu ya mapato ya kawaida

english: Public debt at the end of {fy}
Interest and pensions are paid before anything else.
kiswahili_now: Riba na pensheni hulipwa kabla ya kitu kingine chochote.

english: Equitable share in law, {change}. {pct} of the {fy} development budget was spent.
kiswahili_now: Mgao sawa kisheria, {change}. {pct} ya bajeti ya maendeleo ya {fy} ilitumika.

english: Do not include private or sensitive personal information. You do not need to give your name or contact details. Reports are kept for up to {days} days. A report is a lead for us to check, not a correction, and you may not get a reply.
kiswahili_now: Usiweke taarifa za kibinafsi au nyeti. Huhitaji kutoa jina lako wala mawasiliano yako. Ripoti zinahifadhiwa hadi siku {days}. Ripoti ni dokezo kwetu kuchunguza, si sahihisho, na huenda usipate jibu.

english: Filled in when you came from a figure's "Report an error" button. Otherwise type the page, such as /counties/nyamira/.
kiswahili_now: Hujazwa ukija kutoka kitufe cha "Ripoti kosa" cha takwimu. La sivyo andika ukurasa, kama /counties/nyamira/.
Kiungo cha chanzo cha umma (si lazima)

english: Saved for review. Reference: {ref}. It has not changed any figure.
kiswahili_now: Imehifadhiwa ikaguliwe. Nambari ya kumbukumbu: {ref}. Haijabadilisha takwimu yoyote.

english: The report could not be saved. Please try again later.
kiswahili_now: Ripoti haikuweza kuhifadhiwa. Tafadhali jaribu tena baadaye.

english: Next: the Budget Policy Statement {year}, due in Parliament by {date} under the Treasury's revised calendar (the law's latest date is {legal})
kiswahili_now: Ijayo: Taarifa ya Sera ya Bajeti {year}, inatarajiwa Bungeni kufikia {date} kwa kalenda iliyorekebishwa ya Hazina (tarehe ya mwisho kisheria ni {legal})

english: A public hearing held by the {who}.
Official notices whose dates have passed. The next ones are usually announced on the same sites.
kiswahili_now: Matangazo rasmi ambayo tarehe zake zimepita. Yajayo kwa kawaida hutangazwa kwenye tovuti hizo hizo.

english: Dates announced for the next budget
Announced in official notices. They can come earlier than the dates the law fixes, but not later.
kiswahili_now: Zimetangazwa kwenye matangazo rasmi. Zinaweza kuja mapema kuliko tarehe zilizowekwa na sheria, lakini si baadaye.

english: The latest dates the law allows
kiswahili_now: Tarehe za mwisho zinazoruhusiwa na sheria
